title: Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Sun Country Airlines Holdings filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026 providing supplemental disclosures in connection with its pending merger with Allegiant Travel Company, announced January 11, 2026. The filing addresses two shareholder lawsuits and demand letters alleging disclosure deficiencies in the joint proxy statement/prospectus. Stockholder votes for both companies are scheduled for May 8, 2026.
key_points: Sun Country Airlines and Allegiant Travel entered into a merger agreement on January 11, 2026, with Allegiant acquiring Sun Country through a two-step merger structure
A registration statement on Form S-4 was filed March 27, 2026 and declared effective March 31, 2026
Two lawsuits were filed in New York County Supreme Court challenging the merger: Weiss v. Sun Country Airlines Holdings (April 16, 2026) and Williams v. Sun Country Airlines Holdings (April 17, 2026)
Sun Country and Allegiant received demand letters from stockholders alleging deficiencies in the Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus
Both companies voluntarily filed supplemental disclosures to moot disclosure claims and avoid litigation delays
Special stockholder meetings for both Sun Country and Allegiant are scheduled for May 8, 2026
